program='''def transform(grid):
    """Copy the rare foreground pattern onto every all-zero matching placement."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row if value != 0}
    marker = min(colors, key=lambda value: sum(cell == value for row in grid for cell in row))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points]
    mh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    mw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - mh + 1):
        for c in range(w - mw + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    output[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return output
'''
programs=root/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
print(p.read_text())
